stories.title: AI Rumpelstiltskin goes 'Tip Toein' In My Jordans'
stories.summary: An AI-generated clip styled like a 1980s fantasy film, an imp tiptoeing around a crying woman in a barn before turning the straw into gold, was set to Riff Raff's 'Tip Toe Wing In My Jawwdinz' and took over feeds; one Oct 5 post asking what it was ('I am literally seeing it EVERYWHERE') drew 11,000 likes. Viewers hunted for the 'old movie' it came from before explainers confirmed it was AI, and users swapped in everyone from Supernatural's Sam and Dean to Asmongold.
